text: ## PR description ### [CI] Align MiniMax H3 Ref2VA inputs and add I2VA/Ref2VA accuracy coverage [labels: ready, diffusion-x2v-test, CI/CD] ## Purpose Align MiniMax H3 Ref2VA model-card input handling and keep reproducible official-asset accuracy coverage for I2VA and Ref2VA. - Bound reference video and audio conditions to the generated temporal window. - Preserve RGB reference pixels losslessly through preprocessing. - Normalize audio timestamps so muxed AAC does not expose encoder priming as leading silence. - Expose standalone audio encoding in the MiniMax H3 profiler. - Add SHA-pinned model-card assets and shared metadata/audio/video similarity checks for I2VA and Ref2VA. - Use one accuracy gate for both retained cases: SSIM >= 0.97 and PSNR >= 34 dB. - Remove the obsolete T2VA accuracy case and update the CUDA nightly path. ## Test Plan **vLLM Version:** 0.26.0 **Hardware:** 4x NVIDIA B300, BF16, Ulysses 4, ring 1, HSDP shard size 4, VAE patch parallel 4, tiled VAE, FlashAttention, 50 steps, seed 0. - `pre-commit run --files .buildkite/cuda/test-nightly.yml tests/e2e/accuracy/minimax_h3/test_minimax_h3_i2va_ref2va_similarity.py` - `pytest --collect-only -q tests/e2e/accuracy/minimax_h3/test_minimax_h3_i2va_ref2va_similarity.py` (2 tests collected) - Contract/API validation: 167 passed. - I2VA: SSIM `0.975190`, PSNR `35.981286 dB`, passing the common gate. - Ref2VA: SSIM `0.980577`, PSNR `42.650204 dB`, passing the common gate. - Both retained cases match the official 1344x768, 24 FPS, AAC 32 kHz stereo contract; frame counts are 192 and 124 respectively. The T2VA case was removed from the retained accuracy/nightly coverage because the current strict gate was not met; this PR does not claim T2VA pixel-level alignment. ## Commit timeline (subjects only — the diff below is the squashed net change) - c84ad14b fix ref2va target alignment and profiling - dec18b95 test: add MiniMax H3 I2VA and Ref2VA accuracy cases - c875d7fd test: tighten MiniMax H3 T2VA similarity gate - ef0c0835 test: use common MiniMax H3 similarity thresholds - f1cb3e8e test: remove MiniMax H3 T2VA accuracy case - a9a5e446 ci: update MiniMax H3 accuracy nightly path - cf830ce8 Merge branch 'main' into agent/minimax-h3-ref2va-alignment - ed0bca17 style: format MiniMax H3 contract test - 9f734e3c Merge branch 'main' into agent/minimax-h3-ref2va-alignment - 113749bd Merge branch 'main' into agent/minimax-h3-ref2va-alignment - acb563c3 fix: validate MiniMax H3 audio duration before collectives - 7a92b517 refactor: remove unused MiniMax H3 sampling workdir - 15d83b50 test: strengthen MiniMax H3 reference sampling coverage - 86854432 Merge branch 'main' into agent/minimax-h3-ref2va-alignment ## PR state and gates PR state: MERGED FAILING CHECKS (2): ['buildkite/vllm-omni', 'buildkite/vllm-omni-amd-ci'] — do not re-argue what CI already reports; point at the gate.
